rationale: This empirical study uses multivariate analysis to examine municipal brownfield property redevelopment in small- and medium-sized cities. Although "adequacy of infrastructure" is mentioned generically among property redevelopment factors, the study does not examine household or community water or sanitation service access or water/sanitation access outcomes (E01).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both the narrow and plain readings of Criterion 2 because the study is entirely off-topic (urban brownfield property redevelopment rather than household or community water or sanitation service access).

evidence_quotes.quote: The interest in brownfield redevelopment and reuse in cities has increased markedly as local officials have struggled with balanced growth and related issues.
This article examines factors associated with perceived successes with brownfield redevelopment in a sample of small and medium size cities.
